name: rs-kit-trip-development
description: Seven choices on the same 1800 starting cases: existing rules, integrated defaults, 1.5x risk forecast, lower attack/support/learning priorities and earlier returns. 12600 games.
prespecified: Descriptive development study. Rank fewer natural deaths first; then mean final character level, mean deepest level and DL3+ count, including dead characters. Report all incomplete outcomes separately and paired rescued/newly-killed counts. Candidate settings differ one at a time from integrated defaults, except the earlier-return choice deliberately changes both return thresholds. No winner chosen here is confirmed by the independently fixed confirmation.
owner_authorization: 2026-11-15 owner request: schedule experiments after integrating the finished inventory object-capability updates with the all-item trip-return fix. Fewer deaths first, then character level/depth.
source_notes: All arms use dd3eeac646e097bcdd7c289c092e91400896a713, milestone-12 engine. Control disables both policies; candidates use actual shopping and the all-item return rule. This tests the combined policies, not their individual contributions. All six capability calibration parameters and shared trip/supply parameters are declared and checked against native effective_settings.
